messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER (P1) - cobalt-enterprise - Dedicated pool aurora-dpool-7 — potential exposure: pre-redaction debug logs written to temporary export during failover. Pager: oncall-sre. Dashboard: <https://internal.redwood/incident/2076543210>
Sam Patel: taking this — on-call SRE here. Confirming scope: Cobalt's dedicated pool aurora-dpool-7, right? @Elena_Cruz can you confirm the artifact path and whether data left VPC?
Elena Cruz: confirmed. The write happened to s3://redwood-incident-temp/cobalt/aurora-dpool-7/2076543210/ — object lifecycle didn't apply because this was created by an emergency debug task that bypassed normal redaction pipeline. Data did not leave our AWS account, but objects are not redacted and may contain PII. No external access observed but customer has direct support link requesting raw logs.
Mike O'Neill: @Sam Patel FYI I'm on the call with Cobalt. They say the logs are critical to reproduce their LLM KV corruption and will sign an NDA/LOA. They want a 2-hour turnaround. We need to coordinate legal & sec sign-off before we share anything.
Alice Ng: security here. Do not share raw objects until a formal retention/redaction exception is approved. We can provide a redacted export or a narrow sample first. If legal approves a limited exception we can produce time-limited signed URLs + KMS-encrypted bundle. Steps:
- create redacted export via pipeline (see regex rules)
- run PII scan (pii-scan v2)
- hold raw objects in quarantine bucket with restricted ACLs

Jordan Lee: ops — quick mitigation options:
```bash
# generate redacted export
python infra/scripts/export_redacted.py --src s3://redwood-incident-temp/cobalt/aurora-dpool-7/2076543210 --dst s3://redwood-incident-exports/cobalt/2076543210/redacted --rules configs/redact/pii.json
# revoke any public access
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-incident-temp --policy file://policies/no-public.json
``` 
I can run the export if legal approves.
Samir Rao (Legal): legal here. We can issue a time-bound retention/redaction exception. Need the following before sign-off:
- customer LOA/NDA (scanned & countersigned)
- explicit list of objects + purpose statement
- TTL for access (max 24h)
- audit logging escrow to legal@sales team
If you drop the email + LOA to #legal-requests we can fast-track. ETA 90-120 minutes from receipt.
IncidentBot: Action created: incident/2076543210/export_task=12345, quarantine_path=s3://redwood-incident-quarantine/cobalt/2076543210/raw, export_path=s3://redwood-incident-exports/cobalt/2076543210/redacted — ops_run: pending
Sam Patel: I'm starting the PII scan now, will attach the scan report when done. @Alice Ng can you confirm we should proceed with redacted sample share to Cobalt while legal processes the LOA? If yes I'll push sample to s3://redwood-incident-exports/cobalt/2076543210/sample/redacted-sample.txt
cobalt-soc: Thanks — we can sign now. We'll send the LOA to legal@redwood.com and cc our security contact. For immediate triage, can you share a 10-line redacted sample and the timestamps where the corruption appears? We need to validate it's the same issue.
Alice Ng: yes share redacted sample only. Ensure sample passes pii-scan and remove any GUIDs that could map to customer PII.
Jordan Lee: done. kickstarting export job `export_task=12345` now. Uploading to s3://redwood-incident-exports/cobalt/2076543210/sample/redacted-sample.txt — will post link when uploaded (signed URL, 1h TTL) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Mike O'Neill: I'll confirm with Cobalt to hold off on raw log request until we have legal docs. Asking them to review sample and confirm it's sufficient. If not, they'll escalate to their legal team for expedited LOA.
Samir Rao (Legal): received initial LOA PDF from Cobalt @ 2076543245. Kicking review. If LOA is in order we can approve a 6-hour, single-download exception and require audit logs + key rotation. Keep me updated.
Sam Patel: scan complete — pii-scan found 3 potential matches (emails). I ran redact rules and re-scanned; sample now clean. Uploading sample link below.
IncidentBot: Signed URL: https://s3.redwood.internal/exports/cobalt/2076543210/sample/redacted-sample.txt?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=... (1h TTL)
cobalt-soc: Received sample, looks like it contains the relevant stack traces. We're asking for one more 30s window around timestamp 2026-05-03T18:21:12Z — can you include that in the redacted export?
Jordan Lee: will re-run export for the window, appending to same redacted bundle. Re-running now.
Samir Rao (Legal): LOA approved at 2076543380. Legal exception granted: single-download, 6-hour window, must destroy raw objects after access and provide audit log. Legal will post approval id: LEG-2026-0427-COBALT
Alice Ng: Security checklist to complete before raw share:
- KMS envelope encryption for archive
- Signed URL with 1-hour TTL and IP restriction to Cobalt SOC
- Audit trail exported to legal@sales
- Post-access key rotation + confirmation
Once done, we can hand off raw object link to Mike/O'Neill who will coordinate delivery to Cobalt SOC.
Jordan Lee: packaging raw bundle with KMS now to s3://redwood-incident-exports/cobalt/2076543210/raw-encrypted/bundle.enc — generating signed URL with IP lock. Upload complete.
Sam Patel: final checklist done. Raw access granted to Cobalt SOC via single-use signed URL (ttl 2h) — link posted privately to #secrets (per policy). After confirmation of download we'll schedule destruction of raw objects and rotate keys.
Mike O'Neill: Cobalt SOC confirmed download at 2076543525. They reported the artifact reproduced their KV corruption. Escalation closed from customer side. Follow-up actions:
- destroy quarantine raw objects
- generate and archive audit logs to legal
- run key rotation
- postmortem runbook

Sam Patel: initiating object destroy now. Deletion command:
```bash
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-incident-quarantine/cobalt/2076543210 --recursive
``` 
Destroy complete at 2076543560. Audit logs sent to legal@redwood.com. Postmortem ticket created: INT-2076543210
Elena Cruz: root cause summary: emergency debug path bypassed redaction filters during failover; we will enforce pre-commit redaction + add guardrails to prevent bypass. Timeline: deploy fix to staging in 48h, prod rollout in 7 days.
Sam Patel: closing thread — customer impact mitigated, legal exception documented (LEG-2026-0427-COBALT), follow-up postmortem in #postmortems scheduled for 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC. Thanks all :handshake:
